description: This file declares the 'MetalDevice' class, which acts as a wrapper around an MTLDevice object for Metal GPU operations within TensorFlow Lite's GPU delegate for Metal. It provides constructors, accessors, and a method to check the Metal language version compatibility.

classes.name: MetalDevice
classes.description: A wrapper class around Metal's MTLDevice providing access and utility functions related to GPU device information.

methods.name: MetalDevice(id<MTLDevice> device)
methods.description: Constructor accepting an existing Metal device.

methods.name: GetInfo()
methods.description: Returns GPU information associated with the device.

methods.name: IsLanguageVersion2orHigher()
methods.description: Checks if the Metal language version is 2 or higher.
